answer: Each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through verified contributions; identities that never deliver forfeit stake to honest peers, so mass fake accounts burn capital. Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-stake bonding plus peer-attested work history. Like a trellis supporting vines, the bond graph anchors trust, while reputation flows as slowly as an ocean current across epochs. A tundra-cold audit trail keeps every attestation visible, making cheap identity swarming unprofitable. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
